property.name: yarn.nodemanager.resource.memory-mb
property.description: Task capacity per worker. Deliberately small: the whole cluster runs inside an 8 GB Docker allocation.

property.name: yarn.nodemanager.vmem-check-enabled
property.description: The virtual-memory check misfires inside containers and kills healthy tasks. Standard to disable.

property.name: yarn.nm.liveness-monitor.expiry-interval-ms
property.description: A silent nodemanager is declared lost after 60 s (default 10 min). Its containers are then reported failed and the MapReduce AM re-runs those tasks elsewhere - the YARN half of scripts/failover.ps1.
